Treasure Effects
are skill, stat, and ability altering effects found on looted or crafted pieces of equipment or crafted.
Every
Combat Skill
has its own set of
Treasure Effects.
Some non-combat skills such as
Armor Patching
,
Gourmand
, and
Fishing
also have
Treasure Effects
that can appear on equipment.
Treasure Effects
on an item can be altered with
Transmutation
,
Augmentation
, and
Shamanic Infusion
.
At each page listed in the following table, links to additional pages sorting
Treasure Effects By Slot
and
Treasure Effects By Ability
can be found.
